review_candidates.title: EDR Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking an experienced EDR Platform Engineer-Elastic Security to administer, operate, maintain, and enhance an enterprise Elastic Security and Endpoint Detection & Response environment. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Elastic expertise with solid cybersecurity knowledge and advanced Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Key Responsibilities EDR Platform Administration – Elastic security  Administer and maintain Elastic Security and Elastic Defend (EDR) environment
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Elastic expertise with solid cybersecurity knowledge and advanced Linux administration and troubleshooting skills. Technical Skills Required  Strong hands-on experience with Elastic Stack: Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic Security, Elastic Defend, Elastic Agent, Fleet/Fleet Server, and Logstash. Experience & Education  Approximately 3–5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, infrastructure security, SIEM, EDR, or related technical roles.  Hands-on production experience administering Elastic Stack environments and troubleshooting complex Linux-based systems.  Candidates with strong Elastic and Linux expertise but fewer total years of experience may also be considered. Preferred Certifications  Elastic Certified Engineer, Elastic Certified Analyst, or relevant Elastic certification (preferred)  RHCSA / RHCE.
